title: Puzzle 3D Attraction Input Freeze After Delete
description: After brush + delete object, camera freezes (orbit disabled), selection broken, only hover works. Escape does not recover. Root cause: attraction drag / indirect-pick session not cancelled when fixture structure changes or Escape pressed.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3D freeze after brush + delete: attraction drag/indirect-pick left orbit and selection gated because cancelAttractionDrag never ran when vortices were removed. Added AttractionStaleSessionGuard on structure epoch, Escape cancels session, brush tool blocks and clears attraction drag. Tests: puzzle3dAttractionSessionIsStale + 258/258 react tests pass.
